JRC_APPROVALS.title: Approval Center
JRC_APPROVALS.reportNote: Includes the captured rule, actual authority roster, immutable votes, delegations, revisions and audit. Actor IDs identify the membership at the vote; directory names and delegation revocation dates reflect current records. The report does not execute or approve the source operation.
JRC_APPROVALS.reportError: The report is unavailable. Check your current audit permission, scope and report limits.
JRC_APPROVALS.denied: You do not have permission in this scope.
JRC_APPROVALS.name: Name
JRC_APPROVALS.rosterNotice: Eligibility is checked by the server. For all, quorum must equal the eligible roster; any requires quorum 1. No majority is assumed.
JRC_APPROVALS.typedError: Invalid typed value. Correct it before validation.
JRC_APPROVALS.saveFirst: Save changes before validating, publishing or duplicating.
JRC_APPROVALS.immutableNotice: Published versions remain immutable. Saving creates a new draft; a later publication creates a new version.
JRC_APPROVALS.noRollout: This operation does not change gate modes or activate rollout.
JRC_APPROVALS.presentationOnly: This summary is presentation only. The server validates the structured rule.
JRC_APPROVALS.humanSummary: When the configured condition matches {event} in {company} / {unit}, run {count} approval steps with {mode} execution.
JRC_APPROVALS.absenceAuthorization: Formal absence or substitution authorization reference
JRC_APPROVALS.noDecision: There is no authorized decision available to you for this request.
JRC_APPROVALS.saved: Saved and reloaded from the server.
JRC_APPROVALS.concurrent: Another operation changed this request. Its current version has been reloaded. Review it before sending a new decision.
JRC_APPROVALS.notRequired: No approval required for the current context.
JRC_APPROVALS.delegationDisabled: Delegation is not enabled in this published policy.
JRC_APPROVALS.simulationNotice: Simulation does not execute effects in CRM.
JRC_APPROVALS.noEffects: No request, decision, proposal delivery, order or contract change is performed by this simulation endpoint.
JRC_APPROVALS.error401: Your session or permissions do not allow this action.
JRC_APPROVALS.error404: The resource is unavailable in this account or scope.
JRC_APPROVALS.error409: A concurrent change or policy conflict prevented this action. Refresh and review; nothing will be retried automatically.
JRC_APPROVALS.error422: Validation failed. Review the fields and the server reference below.
JRC_APPROVALS.errorNetwork: Connection failed. You can retry the same unchanged intention safely.
JRC_APPROVALS.shadowNotice: Observation mode — this gate does not block the workflow.
JRC_APPROVALS.unexpectedEffects: The simulation response did not confirm effects=[]. Review the server response before continuing.
JRC_APPROVALS.window_active: Within validity window — voting permission is checked separately
JRC_APPROVALS.author: Author
JRC_APPROVALS.status_GRATUITY_POLICY_REQUIRED: Gratuity blocked: configure and enable enforcement after validation
JRC_APPROVALS.status_GRATUITY_VALUE_PENDING: Gratuity impact pending an official reference
JRC_APPROVALS.confirmDecisionNotice: Confirm this decision for the selected request. The server rechecks your permission, delegation, current source and version.
JRC_APPROVALS.originUnavailable: This approval type has no native source navigation available. No access is granted by this notice.
JRC_APPROVALS.invalidDelegation: This delegation is not valid. Select different eligible users and a valid period without circular delegations.

tiers.field: Value or percentage from the native source
tiers.domainHelp: Finite domain endpoints are included. Complete coverage requires every value in this domain to belong to exactly one range.
tiers.howItWorks: The native approval engine chooses the range for the actual source value. Define the responsible users, roles or native teams in the stages below.
tiers.serverValidation: Configuration summary only. Save, validate and use the native simulator to confirm eligibility. An uncovered value is blocked.
tiers.sourceCurrency: Values use the source currency and are not converted. Restrict currency in the rule conditions when needed. Enter decimals such as 1000.00 or 1000,00 without thousands separators.

domainErrors.INVALID_TIER_DEFINITION: Review the field, currency, domain, range boundaries and selected stages.
domainErrors.TIER_OVERLAP: Ranges overlap. Each value must belong to at most one authority range.
domainErrors.TIER_GAP: Complete coverage contains a gap or an uncovered endpoint. Review the range boundaries.
domainErrors.TIER_NOT_APPLICABLE: The source value has no configured authority range. Approval is blocked.
domainErrors.POLICY_REQUIRED: No active approval rule matches this context.
domainErrors.POLICY_SELECTION_CONFLICT: The applicable rules conflict. Review their selection settings.
domainErrors.INSUFFICIENT_APPROVERS: There are not enough currently eligible approvers for this rule.
domainErrors.AUTHORITY_NOT_APPLICABLE: The configured authority conditions do not match this source.
domainErrors.INVALID_ADJUSTMENT_FIELDS: Only the installed general discount can be adjusted. Enter a nonnegative amount with at most two decimal places.
domainErrors.SOURCE_LOCKED: This proposal is locked. Create a new version through its native CRM screen.
domainErrors.NO_ADJUSTMENT_CHANGE: Enter a discount different from the current value.
domainErrors.ADJUSTMENT_OUTSIDE_POLICY: The adjusted value no longer matches this rule. The source was not changed.
domainErrors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Adjustment is not installed for this type of approval.
domainErrors.INVALID_COMMERCIAL_TERMS: Review the commercial conditions in the source proposal. The adjustment was not saved.
domainErrors.STEP_NOT_CURRENT: The adjusted value requires a different approval authority. The adjustment and decision were rolled back.

adjustment.title: Adjust permitted fields
adjustment.percentNote: The percentage uses the discount base shown here, after existing item calculations. Enter up to four decimal places. The preview shows the monetary amount rounded to cents, with halves rounded up; that exact amount is saved and audited.
adjustment.baseChanged: The source discount base changed. Close and reopen the review before saving.
adjustment.notice: Only the installed proposal discount can be edited here. A new audited request preserves the original requester, policy version and deadline. Saving and approving rechecks the current authority; an ineligible decision rolls back the whole adjustment.
adjustment.saved: Adjustment saved. The new value follows its recalculated approval authority.
adjustment.maximum: Native discount base: {value} {currency}. The saved amount must match the discount actually applied.
adjustment.overMaximum: The discount exceeds the native base. Review the amount; no adjustment was saved.

ownDelegation.help: Delegate only your own approval authority for a defined period and authorized scope. Both people must remain eligible at each use; a rule must permit delegation. No access to edit origin records is granted. Gratuities still require the existing formal-absence delegation for the exact rule version.
